name: MC15UH
tagline: Intel Core Ultra desktop PC with USB4, OCuLink and dual 2.5GbE
description: MC15UH combines Intel Core Ultra 7 255H or Core Ultra 9 285H, Intel Arc 140T graphics, up to 128GB DDR5, dual NVMe storage, USB4 and OCuLink. HDMI, DisplayPort and USB4 provide display connectivity in a 132 x 132 x 50.5 mm desktop enclosure.

specifications.label: Display
specifications.value: 1 x HDMI (8k@60Hz/4K@120Hz); 1 x DP (8k@60Hz/4K@160Hz); 1 x USB4 (4K@120Hz)

specifications.label: Memory
specifications.value: 2 x SO-DIMM DDR5 5600MHz Supports up to 128GB

specifications.label: Storage
specifications.value: 2 x M.2 2280 NVME SSD hard drive slot

specifications.label: Front I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x power button; 1 x RST reset hole; 2 x USB 3.0; 1 x 3.5mm Combined audio interface; 1 x USB4 40Gbps; 1 x OCulink Connect to graphics card expansion dock

specifications.label: Rear I/O - Ports
specifications.value: 1 x DC IN 19V/6.32A; 2 x Intel i226V 2.5G Ethernet LAN; 1 x HDMI 2.1; 1 x DP 2.1

features.title: Intel Core Ultra Platform
features.description: Arrow Lake-H Core Ultra 7 and Core Ultra 9 processor options

features.title: USB4 and OCuLink
features.description: High-speed peripheral, display, and external graphics expansion connectivity

features.title: Dual 2.5GbE Networking
features.description: Two Intel i226-V 2.5GbE wired network ports

applications.title: Interface Layout
applications.description: Clearly labeled front and rear connectivity

applications.title: VC Cooling Structure
applications.description: Fan and VC heat spreader cooling assembly
